tool.name: FasTAN
tool.description: find tandem-repeat arrays and report them as BED6
tool.command: set -o pipefail && #if $input.is_of_type('fasta.gz') #set $fasta = 'in.fa.gz' #else #set $fasta = 'in.fa' #end if ln -s '$input' '$fasta' && FAtoGDB #if $max_n_run > 0 -n$max_n_run #end if '$fasta' gdb && FasTAN -m -p -T\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} gdb && ONEview gdb.1ano | awk -f '$__tool_directory__/ano2bed6.awk' | LC_ALL=C sort -k1,1 -k2,2n > '$output'

param.name: max_n_run
param.label: Bridge N runs shorter than (bp)
param.help: FAtoGDB changes each N run shorter than this length to A. FasTAN can then find an array across a short gap. 0 keeps every N run as a gap.

tool.help:
**What it does**
FasTAN finds tandem-repeat arrays in an assembly. The tool writes one BED6 line for each array.
-----
**Input**
A FASTA or gzipped FASTA file. FAtoGDB does not keep the case of the bases. Thus a soft-masked file and its uppercase copy give the same result.
Each record must contain at least one base that is not N. FAtoGDB stops with an error on an empty or all-N record. The last line must end with a newline.
-----
**Output**
BED6, sorted by sequence name and start. The coordinates are 0-based and relative to the scaffold. N runs do not shift them.
| Column | Value | |---|---| | 4 (name) | `u` and the repeat unit length in bp, for example `u23` | | 5 (score) | `1000 - 10 * divergence`, from 0 to 1000. Divergence is the FasTAN `X` value, roughly a percentage. A perfect array scores 1000. | | 6 (strand) | `.` |
If the input has no tandem arrays, the output is an empty file.
-----
**Option**
*Bridge N runs shorter than* (`-n`) is a FAtoGDB option. FAtoGDB changes each N run shorter than this length to A. FasTAN then reads it as sequence. An array can then continue across a short gap. The A bases count as mismatches, so the divergence goes up.
-----
**Method**
`FAtoGDB` → `FasTAN -m -p` → `ONEview` → `ano2bed6.awk`. The awk script reads scaffold coordinates from the `.1ano` file. It does not use `ANOtoBED`, because ANOtoBED reports contig coordinates under the scaffold name.
